Browser DevTools mastery (used in every phase) · 6/6

6x slowdown: smaller pieces

4 pieces at 6x60 ms
Long-task limit50 ms
8 pieces at 6x30 ms

Without throttling, the handler runs as one task of 40 milliseconds.

That is under the 50 millisecond limit, so nothing is red.

Read the flame chart like this.

Left to right is time.

Top to bottom is the call stack.

An event on top causes the events below it.

Now set a 4x slowdown.

The CPU runs four times as slowly,

so the same handler becomes one task of 160 milliseconds.

A second click arrives at 25 milliseconds.

It waits until the task ends at 160.

The last 110 milliseconds are shaded red.

Split the work into four pieces and yield between them.

Each piece takes 40 milliseconds,

so the click runs after the first piece.

At 6x, each of four pieces takes 60 milliseconds,

so every piece is a long task again.

Eight pieces of 30 milliseconds fix it.
